say:1:1621344001:1.text: Magister, you're wearing that same grim expression again...

say:4:1621344003:2.text: The Memory Star dims, its light settling into silence. A quiet ache stirs in your chest.
say:4:1621344003:2.source_cn: 你望着重归沉寂的记忆之星，心中升起了一丝怅然。

say:5:1621344004:1.text: Cyran has chosen dark magic—and in doing so, has chosen you as his enemy.

say:7:1621344005:1.text: Seeing his talent fall is painful enough. Remembering the laughter and late nights you shared makes it worse. His voice still lingers, proud and sharp, hiding something fragile.

say:8:1621344006:1.text: Even during your student days, your goals in magic were already different. Cyran saw magic as a means of power, which conflicted with your principles.

say:11:1621344008:1.text: Still, you never imagined those differences would lead to this...
